description: the durable-handle lifecycle: request, grant, park across a transport drop, reconnect, reclaim, and the reclaim denial matrix. Oplocks and leases are mandatory because a durable grant is impossible without one of them (MS-SMB2 3.3.5.9.6/.10). Generated but NOT driven -- run_samba_mbt.sh configures smbd with `durable handles = no`, and smb2_replay.py skips any trace whose profile turns a caching capability on, so this cell reports a ctest SKIP.
